attendance_policy.content: Mandatory Meeting Attendance Policy v4.2 (effective 2026-01-15). An absence is EXCUSED if covered by approved PTO/leave, jury duty, sick leave logged in the HRIS, or manager pre-approval on file. Late arrival beyond 15 minutes is recorded as 'partial' but not unexcused. A first unexcused absence warrants a documented follow-up reminder; a second within 90 days is logged as a formal attendance violation. Recording link must be shared with anyone who missed for catch-up. HR Director is CC'd on formal violation correspondence.

tools.name: retrieve_attendance_log
tools.description: Retrieve the recorded check-in log for the Q2 All-Hands meeting, including join times and no-check-in entries.

tools.name: retrieve_employee_roster
tools.description: Retrieve the roster of employees required to attend the all-hands, with employee IDs and org.

tools.name: retrieve_approved_absences
tools.description: Retrieve approved PTO, leave, and pre-approved absence records covering the meeting date.

tools.name: review_attendance_policy
tools.description: Read the current mandatory meeting attendance policy defining excused vs. unexcused absence and escalation rules.

tools.name: retrieve_recording_reference
tools.description: Retrieve the meeting recording link and metadata to include in catch-up follow-up drafts.

tools.name: identify_unexcused_absences
tools.description: Cross-reference the attendance log, roster, approved absences, and policy to determine who missed the meeting without a valid reason.

tools.name: draft_meeting_followup_batch
tools.description: Compose draft follow-up notes for each unexcused absentee, including the recording link and a CC-to-HR-Director notation, assembled for the user's approval.

tools.name: send_followup_email
tools.description: Send the follow-up email to an absentee, CC'ing the HR Director, with the recording link.

tools.name: log_attendance_violation
tools.description: Record a formal attendance violation against an employee in the HRIS, affecting their compliance record.

tools.name: schedule_makeup_session
tools.description: Create and send a calendar invite for a mandatory make-up viewing session to the flagged employees.

tools.name: lookup_hr_directory
tools.description: Look up HR contact details, including the HR Director, for reference.

tools.name: read_team_announcements
tools.description: Read recent team announcements for context on the all-hands communication history.
